meta.name: git-master
meta.description: Handles git work: atomic commits, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and history questions. Use whenever a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skip for ordinary code edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理零散代码改动，变成逻辑清晰的提交记录，并追查每处修改的由来。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你每天都在提交代码，想让每次提交都有条理，也想知道某一改动是怎样来的。
copy.tagline_en: Keep a clean commit history and trace the story behind any code change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Git daily and want clean commits and full insight into your change history.

howto.what: 遇到 Git 相关请求，Claude 会先将其归类为提交、改写历史或查询之一。它只执行你明确要求的操作，动手前先检查仓库实际状态，再运行相应 Git 命令，结束后汇报证据与仍未提交的文件。
howto.when: 当任务需要 Git 提交或历史调查时触发，例如提交代码、查明某处改动是谁/何时/为何引入、压缩提交等；普通代码编辑不会触发。

say.text: 帮我提交这次改动，按项目里的提交风格来。
say.note: 会分析暂存区和历史风格，做原子分组提交。

say.text: 这个文件这几行是谁改的？
say.note: 用 git blame 找出这些行最后的修改者。

say.text: 把最近三个提交合并成一个。
say.note: 进入 rebase 流程，把三个提交压缩为一个。

howto.what_en: When asked, Claude classifies Git requests as commit, rewrite, or history query; it only executes explicitly requested operations, inspects the repo state first, runs the corresponding commands, and reports evidence plus uncommitted files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the task requires a Git commit or history investigation, e.g., committing code, finding who/when/why changed something, or squashing commits; it is skipped for ordinary code edits.

say_en.text: Commit these changes, keeping the project's commit style.
say_en.note: Inspects staging and history style, then makes atomic commits.

say_en.text: Who modified these lines in this file?
say_en.note: Uses git blame to find the last author.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one.
say_en.note: Rewrites history to combine them into a single commit.
